name: Memory Search
description: Search your long-term memory (summaries of past conversations and saved notes) by keywords. Returns matching memory ids with a short summary; use memory_read on an id for the details. Only works for agents with memory enabled.

query.description: Keywords to look for (e.g. 'deploy telegram backup')

deep.description: Also search the full archived transcripts, not just the summaries (slower). Default false.
